issues.description: The Book struct's title field is named differently between artifacts. The problem statement requires a Book with a property named 'title' (and 'author'). In Sources/BookstoreLib/Bookstore.swift of the solution repository the Book struct defines the field as 'bookTitle' (let bookTitle: String). Meanwhile Sources/BookstoreLib/Client.swift in the solution repository accesses book.title (print("\(book.title) by \(book.author):")). This naming mismatch (title vs. bookTitle) will cause compilation errors in client code and confuse students about the expected field name.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the Book struct property to match the problem statement and client usage: change 'let bookTitle: String' to 'let title: String' in Sources/BookstoreLib/Bookstore.swift, and ensure any initializers or references (assembleBookstore, tests, etc.) use the label 'title'. Alternatively, update Client and other callers to use 'bookTitle', but prefer aligning the Book struct to 'title' to match the specification.
